name: convergence-euler
description: Forward Euler for dx/dt = (1 - x)/tau is first order: halving dt roughly halves the error.
derivation: The iterate is 1 - (1 - dt/tau)^n; the analytic value at t = 1 is 1 - exp(-t/tau) with tau = 0.5. The script verified the error ratios (about 0.5) against max_ratio 0.6 and the finest error (about 0.007).
